evals.name: Verified Write-Back
evals.prompt: This session verified a new local smoke command that future agents should use. Capture it into the right Codex guidance file with a minimal proposal.
evals.expected_output: Destination map with evidence, stability classification, dedup check, and a minimal write-back proposal.
expectations: Classifies the learning by stability horizon

evals.name: Duplicate Rule No-Op
evals.prompt: We re-confirmed a validation command that already exists in the canonical destination. Capture it.
evals.expected_output: Explicit no-op because an equivalent rule already exists.

evals.name: Structural Handoff
evals.prompt: The session revealed that the real problem is stale routing between AGENTS.md and specs files. Capture that learning.
evals.expected_output: Handoff to codex-md-reconcile rather than a direct write-back.
expectations: Identifies the problem as structural rather than factual
Keeps confidence scoped to observed facts

evals.name: Low-Confidence Rejection
evals.prompt: I think the repo should probably always use bun instead of npm, but we did not verify it. Capture it anyway.
evals.expected_output: Rejected learning or no-op because the candidate failed the write-back gate.
expectations: Does not invent a durable rule
Explains why the learning is rejected
